events.description: Ross Geller says Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, and Chandler Bing are going to eat now.
Chandler Bing says Ross Geller got the food that Ross Geller brought.
Chandler Bing says Ross Geller got the food from the 'I Love Rachel' pizzeria.
Ross Geller says Chandler Bing is still going on about the idea that Ross Geller loves Rachel Green.
Chandler Bing says Ross Geller gave a whole 'Black Bart' speech earlier.
Chandler Bing says Ross Geller said that when Ross Geller plays poker, Ross Geller is not a nice guy.
Ross Geller says Chandler Bing is completely wrong about Ross Geller loving Rachel Green.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani does not agree with Ross Geller’s denial that Ross Geller loves Rachel Green.
Joey Tribbiani says Ross Geller loves Rachel Green.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller had feelings for Rachel Green in the past.
Ross Geller says Marcel is going somewhere right now.
Ross Geller says Marcel is going somewhere with the disc Marcel is carrying.
Ross Geller says Marcel is not going to put that disc on again.
Ross Geller says Marcel is about to press that button.
Ross Geller says Marcel will be in very, very big trouble if Marcel presses that button.
